tagline: No fake orders. No fake sellers. Real escrow trust for Bangladesh.
heroTitle: Full escrow protection for online shopping, rentals and services.
heroText: The buyer deposits funds into PakkaDeal escrow. Money is safely held until the buyer receives and verifies the product, or both sides confirm the rental/service handover. Only then is the seller paid.
howSub: Three dedicated flows covering physical orders, product returns, and direct service handovers.
howProductText: Seller creates a deal. Buyer funds escrow (product + delivery). Seller dispatches via courier with tracking. Upon verified delivery, the buyer has a 3-day inspection window. Receipt confirmed -> seller paid minus 2% fee.
howReturnText: Return terms are agreed before payment. If an item is damaged or wrong, buyer uploads evidence and return tracking. Seller receives shipping compensation, buyer receives refund balance, and platform retains its service fee.
howRentalText: House rent, freelance milestones, or in-person exchanges. No courier tracking: both sides must press 'Confirm Completed' to release the funds. If a dispute arises, admin inspects evidence.
why1Text: Never lose money to page scammers who block you after advance bKash payment. Your money stays in escrow until you hold the item in your hand.
why2Text: Stops fake orders where buyers ghost the delivery rider at the doorstep. Funds are pre-funded before you dispatch packages.
why3Title: Rules in Code, AI Only Assists
why3Text: Money movements follow immutable deterministic ledger rules. Multimodal AI categorizes unboxing photos and suggests outcomes, but human admins make final dispute decisions.
feesText: PakkaDeal charges a simple 2% fee (minimum 10 BDT) deducted from the seller payout only after successful completion. No upfront listing fees, no hidden maintenance charges.
faq1Q: Is PakkaDeal authorized to hold funds?
faq1A: In our live production roadmap, all customer funds are held in dedicated trust escrow accounts in partnership with Bangladesh Bank licensed financial institutions and payment gateways. The current environment runs on mock sandbox wallets.
faq2Q: What if the buyer never confirms delivery?
faq2A: Once the courier confirms delivery, an automatic 72-hour window starts. If the buyer takes no action and files no dispute, funds are released automatically to the seller.
faq3Q: How does return shipping compensation work?
faq3A: Sellers choose who pays return fees when creating the deal. If an order is refused at the door, the seller is compensated for delivery and return costs directly from the escrow deposit.
